svg.title: Milligrams of minoxidil a day: hair-loss use vs blood-pressure use
svg.desc: Daily oral minoxidil amounts. Off-label hair-loss use in men, expert consensus range: 1.25 to 5 mg. 2024 JAMA Dermatology trial: 5 mg. VDPHL01 once daily: 8.5 mg extended release. VDPHL01 twice daily: 17 mg extended release. Loniten for blood pressure: starting 5 mg, usual 10 to 40 mg, maximum 100 mg. Extended-release and immediate-release milligrams do not give the same blood levels. Not a dosing guide.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: VDPHL01 twice daily is 17 mg a day, above the usual off-label range
